_description: Per-package line coverage floors, and how many projects still declare none. Each floor was measured by running that package with coverage and set a point or two below the result, so it holds today and cannot be lowered tomorrow. The unfloored count only shrinks: a package joining the projects list brings a floor with it, and the rest are a named debt rather than an open-ended exemption.
_measuredAt: fc62f20d4f17aadd8169b95c3d499dcbcfab45a4. Every count was taken on a clean checkout of that commit with this lane applied and nothing else, so no other lane's uncommitted work is baked in; each number sits exactly at its ceiling with no headroom. The ten floors were measured by running each package with coverage in this change.
